how_to_read.tier: stated = the words are in the text; inferred = only implied (offered to the DM as a suggestion, never extracted); needs_context = only readable with the lore or the recap (for example 'she' is Keegan); recap_only = only in the 'Previously' recap on line 1, so background and never this session's event; by_rule = made by a rule, not read
how_to_read.relation: owns, carries, sibling, spouse, member, works_for, knows (+ one of nine feeling words), associate; place ties by word: works_in, last_seen_in; in (only a place inside a place)
how_to_read.must_find: false = a good find if present, not a miss if absent
how_to_read.current: false = history: it was true earlier in the session and is not at the end (the graph shows the most recent relationship, #3363)
how_to_read.line: the line of the session's plain-text export that supports it (blank lines count); 0 = by rule, no line

events.what: Keegan asks for sled dogs; Jebidiah lends two sleds and eight dogs (one is Garret's old sled) and she gives 50 gold
The party leaves Targos about 2 PM and passes Bryn Shander by 3 PM
Two barbarians with chardalyn weapons ambush the party on the road past Bryn Shander; Okthandom is sickened by the chardalyn maul
The party rests and the temperature drops; a blizzard with 30 mph winds comes in and they shelter behind a windbreak
Okthandom speaks of his sister Nyssara and the curse on his family; Vaelrith is named
The Lantern turns green: a monstrosity is within 300 feet, and Belleros says a yeti is near

a plan is not a fact: 'we go to Easthaven then circle back through the dwarven city', and 'the caravan from Easthaven will likely go to Goodmead, Bryn Shander or Caer-Konig' (a prediction, rule 5)
